relevance.rationale: Lecture notes (three 2009-2010 workshops) reviewing the volume conjecture and its generalizations -- parametrized VC on incomplete hyperbolic metrics, the quantum VC (the whole 1/N asymptotic expansion, not just the leading volume term), higher-rank quantum-group invariants, and links in general 3-manifolds -- and recasting all of them inside TQFT via quantization of the A-polynomial character variety. This is exactly the framing prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification asserts (Phi_q as the root-of-unity saddle and Li_2^q as the real saddle of the one A-hat_K(L-hat, M-hat; q) J_N = 0 machinery) and that rem:q-dilogarithm-pentagon-associator leans on for the two archimedean faces of the same pentagon. It is already being used: two audit docs (2026-07-06-qbeta-faddeev-phi-b-modular-double-accuracy.md, 2026-05-24-pentagon-identity-broad-context.md) cite it by bare arXiv URL, with no ref() entry. Review-level, so supporting rather than core -- the underlying theorems are elsewhere -- but the citation gap is real.

keyResults.statement: The quantum volume conjecture organizes the full 1/N expansion of the colored Jones polynomial, and its structure is governed by the quantization of the A-polynomial (the operator A-hat_K annihilating J_N).
keyResults.useForFolio: Gives a citable framing for the corpus's claim that Phi_q and Li_2^q are two archimedean saddles of one AJ operator, which prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification currently states with no source.

proposedActions.rationale: Cited by bare arXiv URL in two audit docs with no ref() entry; a reference key is needed before it can be cited from a block.
The block's Phi_q-vs-Li_2^q context sorting is precisely the quantum-VC saddle framing these lectures develop, and it currently carries no citation for it.
